name: The Adirondack Club Summer Camps
description_short: The Adirondack Club, a fitness and family club, runs three themed summer camps: Adventure Camp, Arts Camp and Sports Camp. Families can pick one camp or mix and match across the summer.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: Only the 2026 season is shown, and it has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). There is nothing yet about summer 2027.

The 'JULY CHILDCARE HOURS' block (Mon-Fri 7:45am-12:00pm, reservations at ext. 203) seems to be about the club's general childcare, not the summer camps, so it was not recorded as camp hours.
